blurb: Guests explore Cape Breton's back country trails by guided side-by-side tours or snowmobile rentals. The trails go through forests, mountains, rivers, waterfalls, beaches, and more, with views, historic sites, and wildlife. Guides are friendly and knowledgeable, and vehicles are suitable for all skill levels.
